name: Look Outside
description: Ideas for resting your eyes and looking at the world beyond the screen.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Ideas for looking up and out, one at a time, shown on Away Prompts.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Look for as long as you like.
howToPlay: Find a window, a door or a view and read the idea.
Press Another idea for a different one.
Press Back at desk when you return.
tips: Ideas are only suggestions. If there is no view, any far corner of the room will do.
